description: The 5 MB per-image cap and the JPEG q95 fallback appear in each shell because each uses its own OS image codec (canvas / UIImage / Bitmap); there is no portable decoder that also handles HEIC. The server re-validates every upload, so a drifted copy costs a worse error message, never a bad row.
note: Change the cap or the accepted-format set in all three copies in one commit. The shells only decide whether to re-encode before sending; the server decides what it accepts.
